judge.rationale: Answers the brief fully: declares design, searches, eligibility, and protocol status; keeps the three publications as separate reports under one NCT03594110 primary study; keeps KDIGO outside the primary-study count; and clearly separates randomized active-trial evidence from post-trial observational follow-up. No duplicate participant addition and no post-trial exposure described as randomized. Derived estimates name inputs and assumptions; safety statements stay trial-derived and do not use derived estimates for practical advice.
